author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: নিচের বিষয়ে একটি informal letter লেখো। নিজে লেখার পর checklist মিলিয়ে নমুনা দেখো (Board: 10 marks)।

items.prompt: Write a letter to your younger brother advising him to be attentive to his studies.
items.model:
Rajshahi
5 April 2025

Dear Rana,

I hope you are well. I am writing to advise you about your studies, as our mother told me that you have become careless about them.

You know that this is the most important time of your life. If you waste it now, you will suffer in future. So, make a routine and study regularly. Do not spend too much time on the mobile phone or television. Prepare your lessons every day and take part in games to keep fit. Always show respect to your teachers and parents.

I am sure that if you follow my advice, you will do well in the examination. Take care of yourself.

Your affectionate brother,
Sagar
rubric: 'Your affectionate brother,' সহ নাম দিয়ে শেষ করেছি

items.prompt: Write a letter to your friend describing a book fair you have visited.
items.model:
Barisal
12 February 2025

Dear Nadia,

How are you? Today I want to tell you about the book fair I visited last week.

The fair was held on the school playground. There were many stalls decorated beautifully. Books of all kinds — stories, novels, poems and science books — were displayed there. A huge crowd of people, especially students, gathered to buy books. I bought some story books and a dictionary. There was also a cultural programme in the evening, which I enjoyed very much.

The fair was really wonderful. I wish you had been with me. Please write to me about your school.

Your loving friend,
Rimi
rubric: 'Your loving friend,' সহ নাম দিয়ে শেষ করেছি
